Read with page_table.py off the page’s OWN TEXT LAYER -- this page is typeset while pages 28-32 beside it are photographs, which is why the reader is chosen per page. Two identities and both close: every project returns appropriated and forward less expended/encumbered/rescinded/transferred as its balance, 50 of 50; and all three columns sum to the printed Grand Total -- 2,621,406.67 appropriated and forward, 1,088,263.42 expended/encumbered/rescinded/transferred, 1,533,143.25 balance. DEVELOPMENT OF CEMETERIES PRINTS ITS APPROPRIATION ON TWO LINES: $15,000.00 on a line of its own with no label, and $37.32 marked `fwd` on the project’s own line. They are recorded as one project at 15,037.32, and the page’s arithmetic is what says so -- 12,187.81 expended plus 2,849.51 balance is 15,037.32 exactly, and the Grand Total does not foot without the 15,000.00.

rows.proof: Bartholomew & Company’s FY2022 trust fund summary, pages 1 and 2 of 2, printed on pages 41 and 42 of the annual report. 46 funds in seven groups, 14 columns. The statement asserts five identities per fund and all of them close, 230 checks: net earnings = net income + realized gain/loss; ending principal = beginning principal + transfers of principal; ending earnings = beginning earnings + net earnings + transfers of earnings; ending cash value = ending principal + ending earnings; ending market value = ending cash value + unrealized gain/loss. Every group subtotal foots its own funds across all fourteen columns, and the seven subtotals foot to the printed GRAND TOTALS on p42. PAGE 41 PRINTS NO GRAND TOTAL -- it is page 1 of 2 and stops at the LIBRARY subtotal -- so the two pages are read and proved as ONE table, which is what the document is.
